annotations.title: Get a Pokémon sealed product price

description: Use this when the user asks what a specific sealed Pokémon product, such as a booster box or ETB, costs, is worth, where it is cheapest, or works out to per pack. One sealed product as its pokefocus.com page shows it: TCGplayer market price with 7- and 30-day change, lowest listing, and price per pack; the 30-day median, low, and high and where today sits; the overbought/oversold reading; TCGplayer supply; the set's top cards; and 30 days of daily market price.

product.description: The sealed product as a PokeFocus id, the slug from its pokefocus.com URL, or the full pokefocus.com URL.

name: get_sealed_product

affiliateDisclosure.description: The affiliate disclosure that applies to the TCGplayer links.

capturedAt.description: When PokeFocus answered; market.asOf is when a price was refreshed.

history.description: Daily TCGplayer market price, oldest first, up to 30 days.

high30d.description: Highest daily market price over the last 30 days, one-day glitches left out.

low30d.description: Lowest daily market price over the last 30 days, one-day glitches left out.

median30d.description: Median daily market price over the last 30 days, one-day glitches left out.

rsi14.description: Overbought/oversold reading of the market price. A fact about recent moves, not advice.

band.description: Oversold at RSI 30 or below with a 5%+ fall over 14 days; overbought at 70 or above with a 5%+ rise; otherwise neutral.

stale.description: True when TCGplayer has not refreshed the price for over 14 days: quote it as the last known price, never a current one.

vsMedian30dPercent.description: Today against the 30-day median, in percent; negative is under it.

sealedUrl.description: The set sealed products on PokeFocus.

url.description: The set card list on PokeFocus.

topCards.description: The set's highest-priced cards with TCGplayer market prices.

title: Get a Pokémon sealed product price
